title: D-024 Amendment 3 unit D: native event integration (hook records, stream-JSON subagent events, dedup, redaction, replay)
objective: Integrate the native hook event bus per D-024-R173/R155 and the M0-T102 matrix (hooks-event-bus, structured-passive-observation areas): probe + fixture the required events (SessionStart/End, UserPromptExpansion, UserPromptSubmit, SubagentStart/Stop, TaskCreated/Completed, Stop/StopFailure, PreCompact/PostCompact, PostToolBatch, Notification, WorktreeCreate/Remove, ConfigChange) on the installed version; durable hook records + stream-JSON subagent event ingestion (--forward-subagent-text >=2.1.211/2.1.219) with deduplication, redaction (no user paths/secrets/masked session data), atomic persistence, restart-safe replay, and unknown-event/version-drift handling; avoid transcript polling where a structured event exists; hooks stay fast, deterministic, sanitized, bounded, and fail closed where security or authority requires (R155). G5 unit-D preconditions: command hooks preferred over HTTP hooks (any HTTP hook constrained by allowedHttpHookUrls/httpHookAllowedEnvVars, no committed tokens); prompt-injection posture keeps the repo sanitizer primary. Any .claude/settings.json hook registration is a separate reviewed change, not silent. Supervisor-freeze qualifying evidence: D-024-R155 + D-024-R173.
business_reason: Amendment 3: hooks as the event bus replace transcript polling; native events feed seam detection, completion gates, and typed failure classification.
outputs: hook/event integration modules under tools/agent_supervisor (recorders, stream-JSON ingestion, dedup, redaction, atomic persistence, replay, drift handling)
hook scripts under .claude/hooks (event recorders only; any .claude/settings.json registration is a SEPARATE reviewed change)
tools/test_agent_supervisor_event_bus.py (firing order, blocking semantics, dedup, redaction, replay, unknown-event)
